question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a silver ball, Eve has a green ball, Fred has a yellow ball, and Gertrude has a teal ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Alice and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) brown ball
(C) grey ball
(D) silver ball
(E) green ball
(F) yellow ball
(G) teal ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (pink, brown, grey, silver, green, yellow, teal)
1. Gertrude and Dave swap: (pink, brown, grey, teal, green, yellow, silver)
2. Claire and Eve swap: (pink, brown, green, teal, grey, yellow, silver)
3. Eve and Gertrude swap: (pink, brown, green, teal, silver, yellow, grey)
4. Claire and Gertrude swap: (pink, brown, grey, teal, silver, yellow, green)
5. Alice and Dave swap: (teal, brown, grey, pink, silver, yellow, green)
6. Fred and Alice swap: (yellow, brown, grey, pink, silver, teal, green)
7. Gertrude and Bob swap: (yellow, green, grey, pink, silver, teal, brown)
Claire has the grey ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
